# Elements Milton Homes
> Independent resource for Elements Milton homes: 60 freehold double-car-garage townhomes by Trinity Point Developments (a division of Greenpark Group) at Bronte Street South and Britannia Road, Milton, Ontario. 3–5 bedrooms, from the $600s. Registration open, targeting October 2026.

## Key Facts
- Project name: Elements Milton
- Builder: Trinity Point Developments (a division of Greenpark Group)
- Location: Bronte Street South & Britannia Road, Milton, Ontario
- Home types: Freehold townhomes with double-car garages
- Bedrooms: 3 to 5
- Total units: 60
- Price range: From the $600s (as of September 2026, subject to change)
- Deposit: To be announced at VIP launch
- Occupancy: To be announced
- Status: Registration open, targeting October 2026 launch
- Last updated: 2026-09-26
- Canonical site: https://elementsmiltonhomes.com/

## Common Questions
Q: What are Elements Milton homes?
A: Elements Milton homes are 60 pre-construction freehold townhomes with double-car garages in Milton, Ontario. Trinity Point Developments, a division of Greenpark Group, is the builder. Layouts span 3 to 5 bedrooms and advertised pricing starts from the $600s.

Q: Who is the builder?
A: Trinity Point Developments, a division of Greenpark Group.

Q: Where are Elements Milton homes located?
A: At Bronte Street South and Britannia Road in Milton, Ontario.

Q: How much do Elements Milton homes cost?
A: From the $600s for the entry 3-bedroom towns as of September 2026. Four- and five-bedroom pricing is confirmed closer to launch and can change without notice.

Q: When do Elements Milton homes launch?
A: The target is October 2026. Registrants get the VIP date, plans, and pricing first.

Q: How do I register?
A: Use the form at https://elementsmiltonhomes.com/#register with your name, email, and phone. There is no cost or purchase obligation.
